title: Inside the Darién Gap
author: Belén Fernández
content:
Belén Fernández in the Darién Gap, 2024. Plastered onto the side of the
glassed-in immigration office at the dock in Necoclí – the northwestern
Colombian city just across the Gulf of Urabá from the Darién Gap – is a poster
warning of the hazards of northbound migration. Over recent years, more than
